column1: # lab fleet membership — the source-controlled answer to "which workers should
# exist on lab, on which workspace, started at what offset".
#   workspace       absolute path; pinned via NEEDLE_WS (no roaming)
#   start_delay     NEEDLE_START_DELAY seconds; spreads launches after reboot/mass restart
#   explore         NEEDLE_STRANDS__EXPLORE__ENABLED (false pins the scan root away from $HOME)
# Seven workers on a 7-core fleet slice = ~1 core per worker. This is the
# 2026-09-09 right-size of the 15-unit fleet that starved during the
# 2026-09-03 CPU saturation (needle-3d5c65d8). Do not grow the fleet past
# the slice quota in needle.slice without raising CPUQuota deliberately.
# Secret-bearing configuration deliberately stays OFF this host-copy list:
